records.jp: 洞窟の地下四階のダンススタジオで、^00文字通りの地下アイドルとして歌い、踊っています。^00入って間もない頃から踊りのセンスや愛嬌が評価され、^00今日も多くのファンの前で癒しを与えています。
records.en_original: An underground idol in a dance studio on level B4. Its talent, idol instincts, and charms are appreciated <CR>by fans.
records.en_auxiliary: An underground idol in a dance studio on level B4. Its talent, idol instincts, and charm are appreciated <CR>by fans.
records.en: It sings and dances in a studio on B4,^00as a literal "underground idol."^00Its dancing talent and charm were recognized almost immediately,^00and today it brings joy to crowds of fans.

records.jp: プレイしてくれてありがとう！^00ゲーム開始時から高いパラメータアップを^00意識してゲームを進めていこう！
records.en_original: Thanks for playing! Be sure to keep raising all of your parameters in mind from the very beginning!
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks for playing! Be sure to pay attention to which options raise your parameters the most from the very beginning!
records.en: Thanks for playing!^00From the very beginning,^00focus on making large increases to your stats!

records.jp: 何事にも動じない戦士グランは、^00闇の洞窟へと旅立っていきました。^00^00・・・そして月日は経ち、^00闇の洞窟へと旅立ったあなたのモンスターは・・・
records.en_original: Grand, who was a strong soldier, left for the Dark Cave.  ...Some time has passed, and your Dark Cave-bound monster is...
records.en_auxiliary: Grand, who was a strong soldier, left for the Dark Cave.<CR><CR>...Some time has passed, and your Dark Cave-bound monster is...
records.en: The unflappable warrior Grand^00left for the Dark Cave.^00^00...Time passed,^00and the monster you sent to the Dark Cave...

records.jp: 洞窟の最深階で傭兵をしています。^00魔王親衛隊に志願をしましたが、^00見た目が怖いという理由で実現しませんでした。^00しかし、腕は確かで誠実であるという事が広まり、^00住むモンスター達の用心棒として慕われています。
records.en_original: Working on the deepest level of the cave as a mercenary. It applied to be a bodyguard, but it got rejected for looking too scary. However, word of its sincerity and skill spread, making it a popular choice for security.
records.en_auxiliary: Working on the deepest level of the cave as a mercenary. It applied to be the king's bodyguard, but it got rejected for looking too scary. However, word of its sincerity and skill spread, making it a popular choice for security.
records.en: It works as a mercenary on the cave's deepest floor.^00It applied to join the King of Monsters' personal guard,^00but was rejected because it looked too scary.^00Word spread that it's skilled and trustworthy,^00and now the cave's monsters rely on it as a bodyguard.

records.jp: 【グラン】^00最終役職：地下五階の強面用心棒^00洞窟階層：最深階^00達成難度：すこしむずかしい

records.jp: プレイしてくれてありがとう！^00よくわからない返事でも、^00試しにやってみると良いかもしれません。
records.en_original: Thanks for playing! Maybe you should try some of the more baffling responses...
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks for playing! Maybe you should try some of the more baffling responses...
records.en: Thanks for playing!^00Even if a reply seems strange,^00it might be worth trying it once.

records.jp: 恥ずかしがりやのヤミコモリは、^00そそくさと闇の洞窟へと旅立っていきました。^00^00・・・そして月日は経ち、^00闇の洞窟へと旅立ったあなたのモンスターは・・・
records.en_original: Yamikomori, who was timid, left for the Dark Cave.  ...Some time has passed, and your Dark Cave-bound monster has...
records.en_auxiliary: Yamikomori, who was timid, left for the Dark Cave.<CR><CR>...Some time has passed, and your Dark Cave-bound monster has...
records.en: The shy Yamikomori^00hurried off to the Dark Cave.^00^00...Time passed,^00and the monster you sent to the Dark Cave...

records.jp: 洞窟の最深階で、^00大魔王に認められて魔王親衛隊の隊長に就任しました。^00しかし最深階は平和で、^00今日も部下の訓練を消極的にこなし、^00雑務をゆったりとこなして過ごしています。
records.en_original: Been recognized by the King of Monsters, and promoted to the leader of its bodyguards. However, even the deepest part of the cave is peaceful, and Yamikomori now spends every day reluctantly training its crew and relaxedly doings chores.
records.en_auxiliary: Been recognized by the King of Monsters, and promoted to the leader of its bodyguards. However, even the deepest part of the cave is peaceful, and Yamikomori now spends every day reluctantly training its crew and relaxedly doing chores.
records.en: On the deepest floor,^00the King of Monsters made it captain of the royal guard.^00But the floor is peaceful, so it halfheartedly trains its subordinates^00and takes its time with routine chores,^00passing its days at an easy pace.

records.jp: 【ヤミコモリ】^00最終役職：魔王親衛隊隊長^00洞窟階層：最深階^00達成難度：むずかしい

records.jp: あなたをただじっとみつめ続けていたヤミアクルは、^00闇の洞窟へと静かに入っていきました。^00^00・・・そして月日は経ち、^00闇の洞窟へと旅立ったあなたのモンスターは・・・

records.jp: 洞窟の最深階で、^00大魔王に認められて洞窟の宰相に任命されました。^00とても平和に見える洞窟内ですが、^00問題が無いか日々色々な事に目をつけています。

records.en_auxiliary: Working as a prime minister appointed by the King of Monsters. It looks like it's at peace in the cave, but it's watching everything like a hawk.
records.en: On the deepest floor,^00the King of Monsters appointed it prime minister.^00The cave may look peaceful,^00but it keeps a close watch each day for any problems.

records.jp: 完全成長を遂げたネクラノミーコは、^00面倒くさそうに闇の洞窟へと歩いていきました。^00^00・・・そして月日は経ち、^00闇の洞窟へと旅立ったあなたのモンスターは・・・

records.jp: 洞窟での生活を始めたものの、そこには何もない日々。^00退屈なのは大魔王が原因だと思い込み、^00最深階まで足を運び、大魔王を倒しました。^00刺激的な出来事に周りは驚き、歓声を上げました。^00そのまま大魔王になり、退屈な日々を過ごしています。
records.en_original: Living a thrill-less life in the cave. Blaming the King of Monsters for its boredom, it destroyed him entirely. While the other monsters were thrilled at the new leadership, Nekura no Miko found its life as the king terribly boring.
records.en_auxiliary: Living a thrill-less life in the cave. Blaming the King of Monsters for its boredom, it utterly destroyed him. While the other monsters were thrilled at the new leadership, Nekura no Miko found its life as the king terribly boring.
records.en: Life in the cave was dull.^00Blaming the King of Monsters for its boredom,^00it went to the deepest floor and defeated him.^00The other monsters cheered at the excitement.^00It became the new King of Monsters, only to be bored all over again.
